nodes.name: Daily Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: You can ignore this trigger entirely and just click 'Execute Workflow' manually any time — it does not need to be active/scheduled for manual runs.

nodes.name: Check Control Sheet (Pause Switch)
nodes.notes: One-row 'Control' tab, column 'Status' = active/paused. Flip to 'paused' any time to stop future runs.

nodes.name: Get Unused Stories
nodes.notes: StoryBank tab columns: ID | Title | Type | SourceText | Used | LastUsedDate | VideoURL. Pre-load ~20+ public-domain fables/rhymes.

nodes.name: AI: Script + Video Prompt + Metadata (Gemini)
nodes.notes: Free Gemini API key from aistudio.google.com — no card needed. Replace YOUR_GEMINI_API_KEY.

nodes.name: Generate Narration Audio (TTS)
nodes.notes: Free local gTTS endpoint (no ElevenLabs restrictions). Make sure ffmpeg_service/app.py is running (python app.py).

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first();
return [{ json: { audio_base64: item.binary.data.data } }];

nodes.name: Split Out Scenes
nodes.notes: One item per scene, each carrying that scene's {description, duration_seconds} under $json.scenes.

nodes.name: Generate Scene Image (Pollinations.ai)

parameters.url: =https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/{{ encodeURIComponent(($json.scenes?.description || $json.description || 'storybook scene') + ', warm watercolor storybook illustration, no text') }}

nodes.notes: Free, no key, no billing ambiguity. Pollinations' documented anonymous-tier limit is 1 request/15s — batched at 18s to stay safely under it. With 8 scenes this step takes ~2.5 minutes total; that's fine for a background daily job.

nodes.name: Extract Image Base64

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first();
return [{ json: { image_base64: item.binary.data.data } }];

nodes.notes: Pollinations returns a binary image file directly, so this just base64-reads it — same pattern as the audio encoding step.

nodes.name: Collect All Scene Images
nodes.notes: Runs once for all items (default Code node behaviour) — collects every scene's base64 image into one array.

nodes.name: Merge Audio + Images
nodes.notes: Input 1 = Encode Audio Base64. Input 2 = Collect All Scene Images. Combine by Position pairs the single audio item with the single images item into one item carrying both fields.

nodes.name: Build Video (FFmpeg: pan/zoom + captions + audio)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ audio_base64: $json.audio_base64, images: $json.images, scenes: $('Parse AI JSON').item.json.scenes, captions_text: $('Parse AI JSON').item.json.narration }) }}

nodes.notes: Sends everything as one JSON payload (base64 audio + base64 images) — matches the rewritten /build endpoint in app.py. No more multipart form fields.

nodes.name: Upload to YouTube
nodes.notes: privacyStatus starts as 'private' for safe first runs — switch to 'public' once you trust the output. Requires the YouTube scope added to your OAuth consent screen.

nodes.name: Alert Me (Telegram)
nodes.notes: Optional — delete this node and 'On Any Error' if you don't want failure alerts.
